highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 delivers Skia m151 with faster managed color, text, and shaping paths.
highlights_body: It adds .NET 11 WebAssembly native assets, restores CPU raster shader compatibility, and fixes a native image-decoding resource leak.

bullets.detail: The bundled renderer moves to Chrome milestone 151 and incorporates subsequent upstream bug-fix and stability syncs.
Restores the legacy shader-context configuration needed to avoid a CPU raster regression.
SKColor hex parsing adds ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads and avoids unnecessary parsing overhead.
SKImage.FromEncodedData with a subset rectangle no longer leaks its native resource.
Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries and exception handling support for .NET 11 WebAssembly applications.
Color conversion, premultiplication, text shaping, tags, and encoded text paths avoid repeated native calls or transient allocations.
HarfBuzzSharp avoids allocations when adding UTF-8 strings and parsing tags.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: WebAssembly build cleanup, .NET 11 native assets, and HarfBuzzSharp performance improvements

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the m151 line and added the initial engine update and WebAssembly cleanup.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 focused on managed performance improvements, HarfBuzzSharp allocation reductions, and upstream m151 fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: The release candidate added .NET 11 WebAssembly assets, restored CPU raster compatibility, and fixed encoded-image resource handling.

harfbuzz_summary: Improves HarfBuzzSharp UTF-8 buffer population and tag parsing to eliminate recurring allocations.

v4.151.0-preview.1.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m151 engine line.
v4.151.0-preview.1.1.body: It begins the update with WebAssembly build cleanup.

v4.151.0-preview.2.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 Preview 2 improves managed rendering and shaping performance.
v4.151.0-preview.2.1.body: It also incorporates current m151 engine fixes.

v4.151.0-rc.1.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 Release Candidate 1 adds .NET 11 WebAssembly assets and compatibility fixes.
v4.151.0-rc.1.1.body: It restores CPU raster shader compatibility and fixes encoded-image resource handling.

v4.151.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 delivers the stable Skia m151 release.
